title: COMMAND BLESSINGS THIS NEW MONTH
text: I want you to share this prayer with somebody. Don't just keep it to yourself. There are people in your life. There are people in your network. There are people in your sphere of influence who [music] need to hear what the spirit of God is saying this morning. The Bible says in Ecclesiastes that two are better than one and a three-fold cord is not quickly broken. When you share this prayer, you are creating a network of intercession. You are building a canopy of divine covering. You are establishing what I call corporate anointing where the prayers of many become a mighty weapon in the hand of God. So before we go any further, I am asking you by the leading of the spirit [music] to share this prayer. Send it to your family members. Send it to your prayer partners. Send it to those who are standing in agreement with you for miracles [music] this month. Let them pray with us. Let them decree with us. Let them command with us. Because what God is about to release is not just for you alone. It is for everyone who will dare to believe and declare. Now, let me take you into the word of the living God. Open your spirit. Open your heart. This is not going to be an ordinary prayer session. This is a prophetic transaction. This is a divine encounter. The scripture says in Job 22:28, "Thou shalt also decree a thing, and it shall be established unto thee, and the light shall shine upon thy ways." I want you to understand the spiritual technology of decree. When God created the heavens and the earth, he did not use physical instruments. He did not employ laborers. He spoke. He decreed. And the Bible says that the word of God is quick and powerful and sharper than any two-edged sword. Your mouth is a weapon. Your tongue is an instrument of creation or destruction. And this morning we are going to use that tongue to command blessings into manifestation. Now listen to me very carefully. The month you are entering is not an ordinary month. I don't care what the calendar says. I don't care what your natural circumstances look like. I don't care what happened last month or the month before. Every new month in the kingdom of God is a fresh page, a new opportunity, a divine reset. The Bible says in Lamentations 3:22 and 23, [music] "It is of the Lord's mercies that we are not consumed because his compassions fail not. They are new every morning. Great is thy faithfulness." If God's mercies are new every morning, how much more his favor, his grace, his blessings in a new month, you are standing at the threshold of supernatural possibilities. You are standing at the doorway of divine opportunities. And the spirit of God is saying to you this morning, command it. Don't beg for it. Don't hope for it. Command it into existence. You see, there is a difference between prayer and decree. Prayer is asking God. Decree is taking your authority as a son or daughter and speaking into existence what God has already made available. Jesus demonstrated this principle when he spoke to the fig tree. He didn't pray about the fig tree. He didn't organize a prayer meeting concerning the fig tree. He looked at it and said, "No man eat fruit of thee hereafter forever." And the [music] Bible says, "The fig tree dried up from the roots." That is the power of decree. That is the authority you carry as a believer. You have been given dominion. You have been given authority. And this morning, we are going to exercise that authority over this month. I prophesy to you right now in the name of Jesus. This month will not be like the previous months. This month, hell will lose his grip over your life. This month, every satanic arrangement against your progress will [music] be dismantled. This month, doors that have been shut for years will swing open by divine orchestration. This month, favor will locate you in unusual places. This month, your name will be mentioned in rooms where decisions are made. This month, financial miracles will become your testimony. This month healing will visit your body. This month restoration will come to your family. This month divine connections will locate you. This month you will walk in supernatural speed. This month delay is canled. This month stagnation is terminated. This month you are moving forward by fire. Now I want to teach you something about the prophetic realm before we go into aggressive prayer. The Bible says in Isaiah 46:10, God declares the end from the beginning. This tells us that God operates outside of time. He sees your entire life from beginning to end as a completed picture. And when you decree a thing, when you prophesy over your life, you are not trying to convince God to do something. You are aligning yourself with what he has already established in the [music] heavenly realms. You are pulling down into the earthly realm what already exists in the spiritual dimension. This is why your words are so powerful. This is why your declarations are not empty religious exercises. You are literally creating your reality by what you speak. The enemy knows this. This is why he fights your mouth. This is why he brings discouragement to silence you. This is why he brings depression to make you speak negatively. This is why he brings fear to make you confess failure instead of victory. But I have come this morning by the leading of the spirit to stir up the prophet in you to awaken the warrior in you to activate the authority that is already resident in you by virtue of your covenant with God through Jesus [music] Christ. You are not a beggar. You are royalty. You are not a victim. You are more than a conqueror. You are not at the mercy of circumstances. You are seated with Christ in heavenly places far above all principalities and powers. Let me show you something. In the book of Deuteronomy chapter 28, the Bible says, "And it shall come to pass, if thou shalt hearken diligently unto the voice of the Lord thy God, to observe and to do all his commandments which I command thee this day, that the Lord thy God will set thee on high above all nations of the earth, and all these blessings shall come on thee and overtake thee." I want you to catch that phrase. Blessings shall come on you and overtake you. This means you don't have to chase [music] blessings when you are in covenant with God. When you are walking in obedience, blessings [music] pursue you. They track you down. They locate you. They overtake you. And this morning, we are commanding those blessings to [music] accelerate. We are decreeing that every blessing assigned to your life will find you this month. You will not miss your season. You will not walk past your miracles. You will not be disconnected from divine arrangements. Now, I want you to lift up your voice with me. Don't be a spectator in your own deliverance. Don't be passive in your own breakthrough. This is your moment. This is your season. Open your mouth and begin to decree. Say, "Father, I thank you for the gift of a new month. I thank you that I am alive to see this month. I thank you that I am standing in your presence with expectation. I thank you that you are a faithful God. I thank you that your word is settled in heaven. I thank you that what you have spoken concerning my life must come to pass. I decree and declare that this month is my month of supernatural turnaround. This month every demonic cycle is broken. This month every satanic pattern is destroyed. This month I am stepping into a new dimension of glory. This month I am experiencing uncommon favor. This month my life is a testimony of your goodness. Father I command every blessing that you have assigned to my life to locate me this month. I command divine opportunities to come my way. I command financial breakthroughs to manifest in my life. I command healing to flow through my body. I command peace to reign in my home. I command wisdom to guide my decisions. I command divine connections to be established. I command promotion to find me. I command supernatural increase to be my portion. I command that every good thing that heaven has prepared for me will be released into my hands this month. I will not labor in vain. I will not struggle without results. I will not walk without reward. My labor is blessed. My efforts are productive. My hands are anointed to prosper in the mighty name of Jesus. I come against every spirit of delay. I bind you. I rebuke you. I cast you out of my life. You will not operate in my affairs this month. Every agenda of the enemy to postpone my blessings is nullified right now. Every satanic conspiracy to hinder my progress is destroyed by fire. Every monitoring spirit assigned to track my movements and report to the kingdom of darkness. [music] I command you to be blinded. You will not see me. You will not find me. You will not locate me. I am hidden in Christ. I am covered by the blood of Jesus. I am surrounded by the fire of God. No weapon formed against me shall prosper. [music] Every tongue that rises against me in judgment, I condemn. This is my heritage as a servant of the Lord. And I speak to the heavens over my life. I command the heavens to open. I command the windows of heaven to [music] be unlocked. I command supernatural supply to be poured out upon my life. The Bible says that God will open the windows of heaven and pour out a blessing that there will not be room enough to receive it. I receive that blessing this month. I command my bands to be filled. I command my storehouses to overflow. I command abundance to be my testimony. I command that everything I touch will prosper. I command that everywhere I go, favor will announce me. I command that every conversation I have this month will lead to divine opportunities. [music] I command that every meeting I attend will connect me to my destiny. Listen to me. There are blessings waiting for you in unusual places this month. There are miracles packaged in divine appointments. There are breakthroughs wrapped in what looks like ordinary conversations. The spirit of God is saying, "Be sensitive. Be alert. Be discerning. Don't be so busy that you walk past your miracle. Don't be so distracted that you miss the angel God has sent your way." The Bible says that some have entertained angels unaware. This month, you will not be unaware. Your spiritual eyes are open. Your spiritual ears are attentive. You will recognize your season. You will identify your moment. You will seize your opportunity. I prophesy over your business this month. Every business that is struggling, I speak life into it. I speak resurrection into it. I speak multiplication into it. That business will not die. That business will not fail. That business will flourish. That business will expand. That business will attract customers. That business will generate profit. That business [music] will become a source of blessing. not just to you but to your generation. I command creative ideas to flood your mind. I command strategic insights to illuminate your path. I command that you will know what to do, when to do it, and how [music] to do it. You will make decisions that will lead to uncommon success. I speak to those who are believing God for employment this month. Your wait is over. Your season of celebration has come. That job you have been praying for, that position you have been qualified for, that opportunity you have been preparing for, it is coming to you this month. I decree and declare that favor will open doors that qualifications could not open. Favor will take you to places that connections could not take you. Favor will give you access that money could not buy. You are stepping into divine placement. You are walking into supernatural positioning. You will not be overlooked. You will not be passed [music] over. You will not be rejected. Your name will be mentioned. Your file will be selected. Your application will be approved. You are hired by divine arrangement. For those who are believing God for marital settlement, hear the word of the Lord. This is your season of divine connection. That man of God, that woman of God that heaven has assigned to your life is on their way to you. I command every satanic delay to be broken. I command every demonic hindrance to be removed. I command that the will of God for your life in marriage will manifest this month. No more frustration, no more disappointment, no more heartbreak. The right person is coming. The covenant partner is approaching. The divinely ordained spouse is being released. And when they come, you will know there will be peace. There will be clarity. There will be confirmation. God will speak. God will witness. God will seal it. I speak to the students to those who are in academic pursuit this month. Your understanding is opening. Your memory is sharp. Your comprehension is quick. You will not struggle. You will not fail. You will not lag behind. I command supernatural intelligence to be released into your mind. I command that difficult subjects will become easy. I command that complex concepts will become clear. I command that when you sit for examinations, the spirit of God will bring to your remembrance everything you have studied. You will excel. You will graduate with distinction. You will fulfill your academic destiny. Now I want to pray for your health. I want to pray for your body. The Bible says in 3 John verse 2, "Beloved, I wish above all things that thou mayest prosper and be in health even as thy soul prospereth." It is the will of God for you to be healthy. It is the will of God for you to be strong. It is the will of God for you to walk in divine health. So I come against every sickness. I come against every disease. I come against every infirmity, every virus in your body, die. Every bacteria attacking your system be consumed by fire. Every pain that has refused to go, leave now in the name of Jesus. Every abnormal growth, every tumor, every cancer cell, I command you to dissolve. Every organ that is not functioning properly, receive healing. Every system that is malfunctioning, be restored. I speak to your blood pressure be normalized. I speak to your sugar level be balanced. I speak to your heart function perfectly. I speak to your lungs. Breathe properly. I speak to your [music] kidneys. operate efficiently from the crown of your head to the soles of your feet. Receive healing in the name of Jesus. And I declare that this month you will not be a victim of any sickness. You will not be a candidate for any disease. You will not be prey to any infirmity. The Bible says you are healed by the stripes of Jesus. That healing is already done. It is already accomplished. It is already available. All you need to do is receive it by faith. So I command you to receive it now. Receive your healing. Receive your strength. Receive your vitality. Receive your wellness. [music] You are whole. You are sound. You are healthy. You are strong. Let me talk to you about your family. I know some of you have been praying for your family members. I know some of you have children who have gone astray. I know some of you have husbands who are not serving God. I know some of you have wives who are far from the Lord. I know some of you have siblings who are walking in darkness. But the spirit of God is saying to you this morning, don't give up. Don't lose hope. Don't stop praying. Don't stop believing. Your family will be saved. Your household will serve the Lord. That son will come back home. That daughter will return to God. That husband will surrender to Jesus. That wife will encounter the living God. I decree and declare that every member of your family who is in bondage, this month is their month of deliverance. This month is their month of salvation. This month is their month of transformation. I bind every spirit that is holding them captive. I bind every demon that is tormenting them. I bind every force that is keeping them away from God. And I lose them. I lose them from addiction. I lose them from immorality. I lose them from rebellion. I lose them from pride. [music] I lose them from unbelief. I lose them into freedom. I lose them into righteousness. I lose them into the kingdom of God. Angels of the Lord, go and minister to them. Bring them to their senses. Bring them to the knowledge of the truth. Bring them to the feet of Jesus. This month, your family will worship God together. This month, your household will become a house of prayer. This month, testimonies will come from your home. I want to talk to you about financial acceleration. The Bible says in Deuteronomy 8:18, "But thou shalt remember the Lord thy God, for it is he that giveth thee power to get wealth, that he may establish his covenant, which is swear unto thy fathers, as it is this day." God gives power to get wealth. This means [music] wealth is not just about money falling from heaven. God gives you power. He gives you ability. He gives you wisdom. He gives you ideas. He gives you strength. And when you combine that divine power with your labor, with your effort, with your diligence, wealth is produced. So this month, I command that the power to create wealth is activated in your life. I command that business ideas will flood your mind. I command that investment opportunities will present themselves to you. I command that you will see what others are not seeing. I command that you will identify opportunities where others see obstacles. And I decree that whatever you lay your hands upon this month will prosper. That project you are starting it will succeed. That investment you are making it will yield returns. That seed you are sewing it will produce harvest. That effort you are putting in it will generate results. You will not work and have nothing to show for it. You will not labor without reward. You will not sow without reaping. This is your season of harvest. This is your season of reaping. This is your season of collecting everything you have sown in prayers, everything you have sown in giving, everything you have swn in service, everything you have sown in faithfulness, this month you are reaping a 100fold. I speak to those who are in debt. Your story is changing this month. That debt that has been weighing you down, that debt that has been suffocating you, that debt that has been stealing your peace, this month it is being cancelled. I don't care how much it is. I don't care how long you have been owing it. I don't care how impossible it [music] looks. The God who paid the debt you could never pay at Calvary is able to pay your financial debt. He's able to release resources. He's able to open doors. He's able to send helpers. He's able to create ways where there is no way. So, I command supernatural provision. I command unexpected income. I command divine supply. I command that money you were not expecting [music] will come to you. I command that debts you thought you would carry for years will be cancelled in days. I command that what looks impossible in the natural will become possible by the supernatural. Now lift up your hands and begin to worship. Begin to magnify the Lord. Begin to exalt his name. When you worship, you create an atmosphere for miracles. When you praise, you release the power of God. When you honor him with your voice, he shows up with his presence. [music] So worship him. Praise him. Glorify him. Thank him for what he has done. Thank him for what he is doing. Thank him for what he's about to do. Let your worship be genuine. Let your praise be sincere. Let your thanksgiving be heartfelt. He is worthy. He is faithful. He is able. He's more than enough. Father, I thank you for your presence in this place. I thank you for your power that is available to transform lives. I thank you that you are not a man that you should lie. Neither the son of man that you should repent. What you have spoken you will perform. What you have promised you will fulfill. So we stand on your word this morning. We stand on your covenant. We stand on your faithfulness. And we command every blessing that you are pronounced over our lives to manifest [music] this month. We will not be denied. We will not be robbed. We will not be cheated. We are taking what belongs to us by divine right. Every power that has been assigned to block my blessings, I command you to be consumed by fire, every witch, every wizard, every agent of darkness that has been monitoring my progress, I command the judgment of God to fall upon you now. Every satanic altar where my name has been mentioned, I command that altar to be destroyed by fire. Every evil covenant working against my destiny, I break you by the blood of Jesus. Every cause spoken against my life, I reverse you. Every evil pronouncement made over my family, I nullify you. Every generational pattern of failure, I terminate you. Every ancestral bondage, I break you. I am free. I am delivered. I am liberated. I am walking in total freedom. And I declare that this month, my story is changing for good. This month marks the beginning of a new chapter. This month signals the end of struggle and the beginning of ease. This month announces the end of lack and the beginning of abundance. This month declares the end of sorrow and the beginning of joy. This month proclaims the end of defeat and the [music] beginning of victory. This month is not like any other month I have experienced. This month is [music] special. This month is unique. This month is pregnant with miracles. This month is loaded with breakthroughs. This month is filled with divine surprises. I command angelic activity to increase around my life this month. I command that angels assigned to protect me will be alert. I command that angels assigned to prosper me will be active. I command that angels assigned to guide me will be diligent. I command that no harm will come near my dwelling. I command that no evil will befall me. I command that I am safe. I command that I am secure. I command that I am covered. The blood of Jesus is upon me. The fire of God surrounds me. The glory of God rests upon me. I am untouchable. I am unreachable. I am inaccessible to the kingdom of darkness. For those who have been battling with fear and anxiety this morning. I speak peace to your heart. The Bible says in Philippians 4 6 and 7, "Be careful for nothing, but in everything by prayer and supplication with thanksgiving, let your requests be made known unto God, and the peace of God, which passes all understanding shall keep your hearts and minds through Christ Jesus. I command that peace that passes understanding to flood your heart right now. Every spirit of fear, leave. Every spirit of anxiety depart, every spirit of worry go. You have no place in the life of a child of God. This month you will walk in peace. This month you will sleep in peace. This month you will make decisions in peace. This month you will not be controlled by fear. This month you will not be paralyzed by anxiety. This month you will walk in the confidence of who you are in Christ. I speak to your mouth right now. Your mouth is anointed. Your mouth is a weapon. Your mouth is a creative instrument. What you say this month matters. How you speak this month [music] matters. The words you release this month matter. So I command you to discipline your tongue. I command you to guard your words. I command you to speak life and not death. I command you to declare blessings and not curses. I command you to prophesy victory and not defeat. Stop speaking negatively about yourself. Stop agreeing with the enemy's lies. Stop confessing failure when God has declared success. You are what God says you are. You have what God says you have. You can do what God says you can do. This month I decree that you are blessed and not cursed. You are above and not beneath. You are the head and not the tail. You are a lender and not a borrower. You are coming in blessed and going out blessed. You are blessed in the city and blessed in the field. You are blessed in your basket and blessed in your store. Everything you touch is blessed. Everyone you meet is [music] blessed because of you. Every place you enter is transformed because of your presence. [music] You are a carrier of God's glory. You are a distributor of God's blessings. You are a vessel of honor in the hand of God. I want you to see yourself the way God sees you. God does not see you as a failure. God does not see you as inadequate. God does not see you as inferior. God sees you as his masterpiece. God sees you as his beloved. God sees you as more than a conqueror. God sees you as royalty. God sees you as his representative on earth. So change the way you see yourself. Change the way you think about yourself. Change the way you speak about yourself. You are not ordinary. You are extraordinary. You are not common. You are special. You are not random. You are chosen. You are not an accident. You are a divine design. And I prophesy that this month you will begin to walk in the full revelation of who you are in Christ. You will begin to operate in the authority that has been given to you. You will begin to manifest the power that is resident in you. You will begin to demonstrate the glory that is upon you. People will see you and ask what has changed. They will see you and wonder what has happened. They will see you and recognize that something supernatural is at work in your life. And [music] you will tell them it is the faithfulness of God. It is the goodness of God. [music] It is the mercy of God. It is the grace of God. It is the power of God. Now I want to close this prayer by decreeing and declaring that the favor of God is upon you this month. Favor will open doors that have been shut. Favor will create opportunities that did not exist. Favor will give you access that you did not qualify for. Favor will promote you beyond your imagination. Favor will connect you with the right people. Favor will position you in the right places. Favor will give you influence in high places. Favor will make your name to be remembered. Favor will cause you to stand out in the crowd. Favor will distinguish you from your peers. Favor will announce you before you arrive. Favor will speak for you before you open your mouth. This is your season of uncommon favor. In the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth, I seal everything we have prayed. I seal everything we have decreed. I seal everything we have declared. It is done. It is established. It is settled. No demon in hell can reverse it. No witch can cancel it. No enemy can stop it. What God has spoken over your life this morning will come to pass. You will see it. You will experience it. You will testify of it. This month is your month of manifestation. This month is your month of acceleration. This month is your month of celebration. Receive it, believe it, walk in it. In Jesus mighty name I have prayed. Amen. And amen.
